testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Exact-head credit is sound only if the commit exists in the claimed repository and is reachable from the claimed PR head or explicitly bound alternative lineage.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A supervisor text field naming an exact head is sufficient provenance.
testable_hypotheses.test: For every credited receipt, fetch the commit, enumerate claimed PR commits, verify reachability and bind workflow head_sha plus decision-step evidence.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: A credited claim survives while its commit is absent, unreachable, or bound to a different PR lineage.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Unresolved safety authority rules must be monotone across control revisions unless a separately reviewed executable retirement receipt names each removed rule.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Human review after accidental deletion is an adequate invariant-preservation mechanism.
testable_hypotheses.test: Diff normalized authority-rule identifiers across every control update and fail CI on deletion without a valid retirement receipt.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: A safety rule can disappear unnoticed while all monotonicity checks remain green.

new_concepts.name: Ghost-Head Credit
new_concepts.definition: Evidence credit is assigned to an exact commit identifier that does not exist in, or is not reachable from, the claimed repository lineage.

new_concepts.name: Referent Closure
new_concepts.definition: Every evidence statement must resolve from claim to repository object, lineage, execution and verdict before receiving semantic credit.

new_concepts.name: Safety-Invariant Tombstoning
new_concepts.definition: Removed authority rules require explicit tombstones with retirement rationale and executable evidence rather than silent textual deletion.
